purpose: Separate the effect of local raw-displacement views on activity localization and on stage interpretation.
scope: Previously viewed simulated development records; not independent validation.
request_order: Ascending case_id; alternate control-first and local-first between successive cases within each experiment.

global_plot.source: Reuse exact visual-v3 raw and auxiliary files, verified by prior request image hashes.
global_plot.axes: N/E/U separate raw panels; same raw calendar and missing mask

local_plot.source: Raw observations only; no annotation, model prediction, scenario, latent displacement or derivative overlay
local_plot.tail: Append the final full-length window ending on the last observation if the stride grid does not reach it.
local_plot.selection: All regular windows, including negative and uncertain regions; no label- or error-selected crops.
local_plot.axes: N/E/U in three rows, windows as columns; original day indices; observed gaps remain gaps
local_plot.axis_noise: max(1.4826 * median absolute deviation of finite consecutive daily differences / sqrt(2), 0.1 mm), computed per axis from the full observation record
local_plot.axis_range: max(all finite local raw values)-min(all finite local raw values); no outlier clipping

experiments.control: Fresh single activity call with global raw image only.
experiments.treatment: Fresh single activity call with the same global raw image plus every fixed local raw page.
experiments.prompt: ACTIVITY_TASK plus the identical activity/uncertain JSON schema instruction for both arms.
experiments.auxiliary_evidence: None in either arm; activity must be confirmed from raw displacement.
primary_metrics: weak activity recall with support count
experiments.interpretation: A localization-only comparison; do not use these newly inferred gates to change the separate stage experiment.

experiments.control: One fresh stage call with frozen visual-v3 activity gate, global raw image and the same 61-day auxiliary image.
experiments.treatment: One fresh stage call with exactly the same activity gate and global/auxiliary images plus every fixed local raw page.
experiments.prompt: Reuse the exact visual-v3 per-case stage prompt; same inclusive endpoint contract and no additional examples.
primary_metrics: end-to-end stage macro-F1 under the fixed activity gate
experiments.interpretation: Controlled stage-evidence comparison; this is not an end-to-end run of the newly localized activity arm.

cost_policy: The number of calls and maximum output tokens match. Image counts and actual input tokens differ intentionally; report them and do not claim a token-matched experiment.
scoring: Reuse current landslide_evaluation.py without changes. Unknown reference days excluded, positive misses retained, output failures retained; no sorting, clipping, retries or post-hoc label corrections.
freeze_policy: Freeze source snapshots, prompts, input/image hashes and this configuration hash before the first request. No parameter search or repeat selection after outputs. Record protocol deviations separately.
interpretation_limits: Only one weak-motion reference episode and 42 steady-reference days. No confirmatory significance, noninferiority, cross-site, online-warning, or physical-failure claims. Labels themselves remain subject to independent adjudication.
